_note: Example topics for paper_network.py. Copy to paper_topics.json and write your own. Each query is a PubMed search; {SUFFIX_AD} expands to a company-suffix affiliation filter, the highest-yield way to surface industry authors. Keep each query under 20 boolean operators. exclude_orgs drops organizations you will not work for.

topics.name: Diabetes prevention RWE
queries: ("diabetes prevention" OR prediabetes) AND ("real-world" OR claims OR "electronic health records") AND {SUFFIX_AD}

topics.name: Physical activity and digital health
queries: ("physical activity" OR wearable OR "step count") AND ("real-world" OR "machine learning" OR "cost-effectiveness") AND {SUFFIX_AD}
